70442-the-barnum-bailey-greatest-show-on.title: The Barnum Bailey Greatest Show On Earth Songster
70442-the-barnum-bailey-greatest-show-on.creator: Unknown
70442-the-barnum-bailey-greatest-show-on.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. When homeward I stray at the close of the day,  So wearied with labor and care,  My heart soon grows light, with the vision so bright,  Of the face that is waiting me there,  As she stands in the window with mother close by,  Who softly strokes each little curl;  And soon as she sees me, so gladly she’ll cry,  My own little dear baby girl!

arxiv-2112-14437.title: A Color Image Steganography Based on Frequency Sub-band Selection
arxiv-2112-14437.creator: Hai Su, Shan Yang, Shuqing Zhang, Songsen Yu
arxiv-2112-14437.description: Abstract Color image steganography based on deep learning is the art of hiding information in the color image. Among them, image hiding steganography(hiding image with image) has attracted much attention in recent years because of its great steganographic capacity. However, images generated by image hiding steganography may show some obvious color distortion or artificial texture traces.

arxiv-2201-08875.title: Information-Based Trading
arxiv-2201-08875.creator: George Bouzianis, 1 Lane P. Hughston, 1 and Leandro Sánchez-Betancourt 2,3
arxiv-2201-08875.description: Abstract We consider a pair of traders in a market where the information available to the second trader is a strict subset of the information available to the first trader. The traders make prices based on information concerning a security that pays a random cash flow at a fixed time T T in the future.

arxiv-2203-11985.title: A temporal-averaging based approach to toughness homogenisation in heterogeneous material
arxiv-2203-11985.creator: G. Da Fies, D. Peck, M. Dutko, G. Mishuris
arxiv-2203-11985.description: Abstract A new approach to defining the effective fracture toughness for heterogeneous materials is proposed. This temporal averaging approach is process-dependent, incorporating the crack velocity and material toughness. The effectiveness of the new technique is investigated in the context of hydraulic fracture through heterogeneous rock with a periodic material toughness.

arxiv-2505-22432.title: Oblique Multiple Scattering by Gyrotropic Cylinders
arxiv-2505-22432.creator: Grigorios P. Zouros, Konstantinos Delimaris, Carsten Rockstuhl, Georgios D. Kolezas
arxiv-2505-22432.description: Abstract In this work, we develop a full-wave vectorial solution for the 2.5-dimensional (2.5-D), i.e., at oblique plane wave incidence, electromagnetic (EM) multiple scattering (MS) by a collection of gyrotropic cylinders. All cylinders are infinitely long and share a common z z -axis.

pmc-12615979.title: Beyond bacteria and breaking the norm: Pulmonary mucormycosis due to Absidia corymbifera in a child with primary ciliary dyskinesia
pmc-12615979.creator: Abdulrahman O Alghamdi, Fawzyh J AlKhadidi, Abdulraouf H Alawur, Safiya Alkhaldi, Lura Habib, Roaa Alharbe, Abdulelah S Algethami, Nejood M Aljaed, Salma AS Abosabie, Sara A Abosabie, Naglaa M Kamal
pmc-12615979.description: Primary ciliary dyskinesia is a rare autosomal recessive disorder that impairs mucociliary clearance and predisposes children to chronic respiratory infections. Invasive fungal infections caused by Lichtheimia (Absidia) corymbifera are typically confined to profoundly immunocompromised hosts and are exceptionally uncommon in patients without systemic immunosuppression.

pmc-12706464.title: The Earliest Known Photo-Documented Rhytidoplasty and Mastopexy (1908): Jules Poullet and the 21st French Surgical Congress
pmc-12706464.creator: Danny J Soares
pmc-12706464.description: Aesthetic surgery's present popularity contrasts with its late-nineteenth-century beginnings in commercial “beauty institutes,” where limited, skin-only cosmetic procedures emerged outside the surgical mainstream and left little contemporaneous record. This article reassesses that early period and highlights a neglected primary source: Jules Poullet's 1908 lecture at the 21st French Surgical Congress, published with photographic documentation.
